# CLOC by Daniel Lugo — Portfolio

> Graphic design portfolio of Daniel Lugo (CLOC), a Venezuelan designer with over 5 years of experience specializing in branding, photomanipulation, and strategic visual design for Web3, cryptocurrency, and blockchain ecosystems.

## About
- Name: Daniel Lugo
- Brand: CLOC
- Location: Venezuela
- Specialization: Branding, Graphic Design, Photomanipulation, Web3, Cryptocurrency
- Website: https://www.clocdesign.net

## Featured Projects
- SyFu: Social media visual identity for a fitness brand
- YouCoin: Cyberpunk visual ecosystem for a Metaverse platform
- Tashi Network: Blockchain infrastructure branding
- Zaro Coin: Cryptocurrency social media design system
- Workflow717: Visual identity for streetwear brand
- Rag 'N' Mop: Motion and visual design for clothing brand
